decided_by: Malcolm: the banner's right side must stay fully in view at every screen width — on his laptop the droplet was half cut off
note:
MEASURED, NOT GUESSED. The hero box is `content-over-media--sm`: a fixed PIXEL height (375 / 400 / 440px at <700 / >=700 / >=1400) across a full-bleed width, so its shape changes with the viewport while the master does not. The master is 3000x688 (4.36:1), built to fill exactly 1920x440. `object-fit: cover` on a fixed-height box scales by height alone, so every pixel of surplus width is cropped from the sides — and the theme's default `object-position: center` splits that crop evenly.

Measured on the live page:
  1920x440 -> renders 1920 wide, 0px cropped (the design case)
  1512x440 -> 407px cropped, 204 off the RIGHT edge
  1440x440 -> 479px cropped, 240 off the RIGHT edge
  1280x400 -> 465px cropped, 232 off the RIGHT edge

The subject sits hard right: bright content runs from x=1826 to x=3000 in the master, with the caustic core from x=2229. So 240 rendered px off the right edge is ~375 source px — it takes the right side of the droplet and the end of the caustic clean off. That is the 'only half in view' Malcolm reported.

FIX: pin the image to its right edge. `object-position: right center` keeps the right side flush with the box at every width, so the crop only ever eats the LEFT extension — which is deliberately empty graphite backdrop (column mean 20.7 at x=0, rising to 23.8 by x=1000, no structure). Nothing recognisable is lost at any width.

Headroom check, pinned right: the visible source window is `viewport * 688/440` px wide, measured back from x=3000. At 1280 it starts at x=798, at 1440 at x=748, at 1512 at x=636 — all far left of the subject's x=1826. The subject only begins to clip below a ~751px viewport, and the separate `mobile_image` takes over at 699px. So the droplet and caustic are whole across the entire desktop range.

WHY NOT `object-fit: contain`: it would letterbox a 4.36:1 master into a 3.27:1 box — 110px of dead band at 1440 — and shrink the subject. The box is a height, not an aspect ratio; cover plus a right pin is the only fit that keeps the subject at full scale.

WHY NOT `image_size: auto`: tried and rejected 2026-08-24 (ADR-005). It makes this header taller than every other page, and the image is a grid item spanning every row, so `auto` stretches it to the text height and cover then crops the SIDES instead.

TEXT: the heading is `sm:place-self-center-start sm:text-start` — hard left, i.e. the opposite side from the subject, so pinning right moves the picture AWAY from the type, not under it. The visible left region measures column-mean 23-31 across every desktop width, which is clean ground for white.

DELIVERY: a `liquid` block inside the section, so `{{ section.id }}` resolves at render time. A `custom-html` section would 422 on the Liquid, and a hardcoded template id goes stale silently — the brightening-glow page still carries one that matches nothing. Same shape as the working block on /pages/the-science.
